# Is your security.txt still valid — or quietly expired?

> Checks a security.txt against RFC 9116 — including the expiry date that quietly turns a valid file into a stale one, which is the state most published security.txt files are in.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
